identity_policy.acceptance: Accepted battle, adventure and portrait assets require checksum-bound native-size identity review under assets/reviews.
identity_policy.rule: Local guides and Path Wardens, living quill-firing Bristlehogs, adult Pakaa, living Stoneshapers, Hallunatis birds and Pairofants. Four walking-melee, two finite physical ranged and one flying-melee line in both variants. This regional-defense/ecological coalition is an explicit adaptation, never a canonical standing national army or mass-produced champions.

original_resource_references: Structure and rendering language only: original Heroes III creature, town and siege layouts measured for scale.
release_policy: Every required output needs an approved source, a recorded checksum, redistribution rights and native-size visual acceptance. No placeholders.
visual_direction: Painted 2D original Heroes III compatibility; cultivated jungle-edge arcology community, jade/ivory shaped stone, ochre/green woven cloth and timber. Plan entire building silhouettes, dry foundations and connected doors/roads before painting. Visible correct Ixtal crests in locally credible materials; bounded mineral and feather accents, no 3D or imported desert/Spirit Blossom design.
